metrics.suite: Original work sizes, both WeavePy execution modes, all 24 fixtures. One discarded cycle, alternating interpreter order; retain all measured samples.
metrics.ratios: Median of ratios within paired cycles; values below 1 improve the metric.
metrics.cpu_and_rss: Full-process CPU time and peak resident memory; supplemental probes additionally time workload CPU. JSON/string probes disable the JIT and time one bench() invocation per process; one complete process cycle is discarded.
metrics.profiling: Flat sampling identifies candidate bottlenecks; profiles were collected during compilation and are not throughput measurements.
metrics.not_measured: Energy, controlled build time, allocation counts, service tail latency, and other hardware platforms.
metrics.json_probe_files: Twelve valid baseline/candidate/CPython probes in probes.json. Two additional surrogate probes in surrogates.json; the baseline encoder fails its workload assertion and has no performance ratio. See probe-baseline-error.txt.
metrics.scaling: Initial mixed-mode run, an explicit CPython reference, and a seven-cycle follow-up isolating each GIL mode are all retained. Mixed-mode results show order sensitivity after the heavier free-threaded processes. The isolated GIL-enabled comparison is within 0.2% for serial and parallel workload time.

validation.fixture_runner: 87 existing Python fixtures executed through the final CLI and compared byte for byte with their .out files. Localhost socket and subprocess access enabled.
validation.json_oracles: 250 encodings, 281 decodings, 219 malformed-input positions per mode; JIT, interpreter, gil=0. Generated with CPython 3.14.7 using verify.py.
validation.initial_candidate: validation.json was measured before removing the operand experiment; final JSON checks are recorded separately.
validation.final: All 104 checks passed on the final JSON and string release, including directional bounds; see validation-final.json.

before_prefix: before-prefix/ retains measurements for the UTF-8 JSON candidate before removing whole-string indexes in prefix/suffix checks and bounded rsplit. These are intermediate results, not the final release.
before_bounds: before-bounds/ retains the full suite before optimizing positive and negative string bounds. Its JSON and unbounded prefix/suffix optimizations are the same as the final release.
